entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Perf improvement: updates #63294
  • Bad wwwroot path in Blazor 9 with ubuntu 24 and ProcessStartInfo #63295
  • Better SWA docs #63292
    Backlog
  • Minimal API Validation should respect [JsonPropertyName] #63290
  • Minimal API Validation includes validation for service provider service #63289

Closed

  • Duplicate Accept-Ranges Header when using MapStaticAssets #56436
    Backlog
  • PersistentState doesn't work on non-public properties #63268
  • API Proposal for IApiEndpointMetadata #62883
    10.0-rc1
  • [OpenAPI] Invalid schema references generated #63090
    .NET 10 Planning
  • WebApplicationFactory doesn't set solution relative content root if you switch to slnx solution #61304
    .NET 10 Planning
  • Update Minimal API validation logic for backwards compatibility #62584
    10.0-rc1

Created

  • [release/10.0-rc1] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #63293
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:

    community-contribution, area-minimal, feature-validation
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #63288

    area-networking, 10.0-rc1

    area-infrastructure

    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-networking, 10.0-rc1

    community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, area-networking

    area-mvc, community-contribution, feature-openapi, pr: pending author input, pending-ci-rerun

    area-mvc, community-contribution
